messages:
tom_packaging: FYI packaging team finished the VPC airgap bundle for customer ACME; need deploybot slot and signer TTL check before we publish. small delta: using reduced-layer tarball + v2 manifest.
sara_release: thanks tom — what's the preferred canary window? customer asked for 2h canary w/ manual hold point.
anna_ops: We should avoid the 04:00 UTC change window. Prefer 14:00-16:00 UTC so APAC teams are awake.
tom_packaging: agree 14:00-16:00 UTC. also added cosign signatures and submanifest with epoch: 2026-03-21T14:00Z. snippet: ```json
{"manifest_version":"2","submanifests":[{"id":"acme-vpc","digest":"sha256:aaa..."}],"signer":"pkg-signer-v3","ttl":"72h"}
```
sara_release: deploy-bot can you schedule a canary for 2026-03-21T14:10Z for 30m, then hold for manual verify? tag: acme-vpc-20260321
deploy-bot: @sara_release scheduled canary: start=2026-03-21T14:10:00Z duration=30m route=private-vpc/acme-vpc tag=acme-vpc-20260321. Next automated window: 14:40Z for full rollout if hold is released.
anna_ops: deploy-bot, add emergency rollback hook referencing manifest tag and the following command: `rbctl revert --manifest acme-vpc-20260321 --to-tag acme-vpc-20260314`
deploy-bot: rollback hook added. Confirmed rollback threshold: 5% error rate OR avg token latency > 800ms for 3 consecutive minutes.
devsec_lee: quick security check: signer TTL=72h is fine but confirm KMS access window for customer ops. If signer expires mid-delivery we must have pre-signed transport artifacts.
tom_packaging: noted. I'll export pre-signed transport layers to the secure bucket and add transport-hash file. command I ran: `./build-airgap --submanifest acme-vpc --export presigned://s3/acme/transport-20260321.tar.gz`
ops_jane: I need the release notes blurb for the customer-facing pack. draft: "ACME private deployment: packaged v2 manifest, cosigned bundles, 2-hour canary window with manual verification. Rollback safepoint: 2026-03-14 snapshot." Can someone approve?
sara_release: LGTM, add the note about rollback latency threshold and the canary hold.
anna_ops: also include contact matrix: tom_packaging, ops_jane, sara_release, oncall (eng-oncall).
tom_packaging: approvals acked. One more ops ask — if canary fails we should unpin downstream registries. proposal: during rollback we will unpin the deployed tag and pin previous tag at mirror edge.
sara_release: agreed. @deploy-bot add policy: on rollback -> run mirror-pin --target=acme-edge --pin=acme-vpc-20260314 --timeout=600s
deploy-bot: policy added. Will emit a follow-up message 10m before canary start with artifact checksums and cosign verification.
ops_jane: final check: cosign sigs verified? tom_packaging can you paste `cosign verify-blob` output?
tom_packaging: pasted below:
```
$ cosign verify-blob --key $KEY submanifest.json
Verified signature for sha256:aaa... by pkg-signer-v3
Verification: OK
```
sara_release: perfect. moving to final prep. please be on standby at 13:50 UTC for handover. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: reminder scheduled: 2026-03-21T13:50:00Z prep ping -> channel eng-releases.
anna_ops: noted. If hold is released we'll start full rollout at 14:40 UTC, otherwise abort and run rollback by 15:00 UTC."
